entities.name: Count Aymar de la Baume Pluvinel

entities.summary: Count Aymar Eugène de la Baume Pluvinel was a French astronomer and professor in the Grandes écoles SupOptique. He belonged to an old noble family, whose most famous descendant was Antoine de Pluvinel, King Louis XIII's master of equitation.
